Method of Attack: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via ClassLoader manipulation
Tomcat context reconfiguration to write arbitrary JSP files
Impacted Systems: Spring Web applications running on Java 9 and later
Attack Vector: POST requests with POJOs to trigger binding
Accessing ClassLoader variables via POST parameters prefixed by class.module.classLoader.*
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious JSP files created in Tomcat's web application root
